埃文塔多的车窗降下，川介雄一不屑地看了眼聂伊辰，李恒江更是做了个拇指朝下的动作，对着聂伊辰喊道：“聂伊辰，让你的高柳山车神带你装B，带你飞，哈哈哈……”
聂伊辰冷哼一声，关上了车窗，没有理会川介雄一和李恒江的挑衅。
陈阳瞥了眼李恒江，鄙视道：“飚个车还找RB人，这种人在抗战时期，肯定就是个汉奸。”
就在这时，一名穿着比基尼，身材高挑性感的嫩模举着两面小红旗，扭着腰站在了两辆汽车前方中间，高高交叉举起了小红旗。
三、二、一，两面红旗落下，嫩模的峰峦也随之一抖，紧接着，整条街道响起了此起彼伏的汽车排气吼声。
埃文塔多的性能明显强了太多，弹射起步，第一个冲了出去，老捷达紧随其后。
再后面，才是其他各种车辆，虽然也有堪比埃文塔多的超跑，但这些人的驾驶技术明显逊色很多，被落在了后面。
五十多台汽车呼啸而过，声势浩大，排气轰鸣，吸引了所有路人的目光。
聂伊辰看着埃文塔多的尾灯，皱了下眉头，全神贯注地开着车，努力想要追赶埃文塔多，却发现每每靠近一点，就被对方甩开。
“这个RB鬼子，竟然敢玩我。”
聂伊辰回过神来，这才发现，那个叫川介雄一的RB车手是在故意挑衅她，气得她是咬牙切齿。
随着比赛的进行，川介雄一和聂伊辰渐渐和后方其他车手拉开了距离，两人在街道上穿梭，速度越来越快，开上了环道之后，更是达到了180码的速度。
“哈哈，聂伊辰，你输定了。”
前方的埃文塔多装了扩音器，里面传来李恒江得意的声音，然后埃文塔多轰鸣一声，速度明显加快，和老捷达拉开了距离。
“混蛋。”
聂伊辰暗骂一句，知道今天如果没有意外，那她肯定是输定了。
转了个急弯，前方突然传来警笛的声音，只见一排警车将环道完全拦截，红蓝的灯光闪烁着刺目的光芒。
“前方车辆靠边停下，接受检查。”
警车传来声音，聂伊辰皱起了眉头，环道封闭，此刻她想换道都不行，只能掉头逆行了。
于此同时，前方的埃文塔多也是相同的想法，减速之后，180度的漂移，轮胎摩擦扬起白色的刺鼻浓烟，下一刻已是掉转方向，逆行加速。

聂伊辰右手放在了手刹上，她也打算漂移掉头。
可就在此时，陈阳一把将她提了起来，身形一纵，已是钻到了她的身下，坐在了驾驶席上，掌控住方向盘道：“嘿嘿，逆行的话，可是不能到达终点的。”
聂伊辰吓了一跳，靠在陈阳的身上，惊呼道：“你干什么？”
“帮你。”
陈阳话音一落，脚下油门深踩，老捷达朝着掉转方向的埃文塔多正面冲了上去，聂伊辰顿时吓傻了，尖叫起来：“啊！”
不止是聂伊辰，坐在埃文塔多里的李恒江和川介雄一也是傻了，川介雄一连忙踩下刹车减速。
两车的速度都很快，眼看就要撞击在一起，周围的警察以为要发生爆炸，连忙躲在了警车后面。
可奇异的一幕发生，只见老捷达车头点了下，速度明显降低，然后突然扬头，车头竟然翘了起来，骑上了冲击而来的埃文塔多，从埃文塔多身上开过，直接飞了起来，从拦截的警车头顶飞过。
躲在警车后的叶以晴朝着老捷达看去，目瞪口呆，今晚她接到命令，执行拦截飙车党的任务，却没想到会看到这样的汽车特技。
紧接着，更令她没想到的一幕出现在眼前，自己的房东陈阳，竟然出现在老捷达的驾驶席上。
“怎么会是他？”叶以晴面色一变，仔细一看发现陈阳的身上竟然还坐着一个女的，她顿时皱起了眉头：“这家伙果然不是好东西，飙车居然还坐个女人在身上，而且还是个非主流，什么破眼光。”
哐当一声，老捷达碾过埃文塔多，飞跃警车，落在了车道上，绝尘而去，丢下一众傻眼了的警察。
埃文塔多停了下来，川介雄一和李恒江都是目光呆滞地盯着前方，吓得满头大汗，面色煞白，刚才老捷达冲过来的时候，他们俩都以为这辈子就这样完蛋了。
看着包围过来的警察，李恒江回过神来，想起刚才坐在驾驶席的陈阳，他一拳重重地砸在门板上，恶狠狠地骂道：“混蛋，竟然被那小子骗了，我一定不会放过他。”

content_en:
The window of the Aventador was lowered. Kawasuke Yuichi glanced at Nie Yichen with disdain. Li Hengjiang even pointed his thumb down and shouted to Nie Yichen: "Nie Yichen, let your Gaoliushan Car God take you to pretend to be B and take you flying, hahaha..."
Nie Yichen snorted coldly, closed the car window, and ignored the provocations of Kawasuke Yuichi and Li Hengjiang.
Chen Yang glanced at Li Hengjiang and said with disdain: "You are looking for someone from RB to drive a car. This kind of person must have been a traitor during the Anti-Japanese War."
At this moment, a tall and sexy young model wearing a bikini held up two small red flags, twisted her waist and stood in the middle of the two cars, holding the small red flags high and crossed.
Three, two, one, two red flags fell, and the young model's peaks trembled. Then, the whole street rang with the roar of car exhausts one after another.
The performance of the Aventador was obviously much stronger. It ejected and rushed out first, followed closely by the old Jetta.
Behind them are various other vehicles. Although there are also supercars that are comparable to the Aventador, their driving skills are obviously much inferior and they are left behind.
More than fifty cars roared past with great momentum and roaring exhausts, attracting the attention of all passers-by.
Nie Yichen looked at Aventador's taillights and frowned. He drove the car with all his concentration, trying hard to catch up with Aventador, but found that every time he got closer, he would be thrown away.
"This RB devil dares to play with me."
When Nie Yichen came back to her senses, she realized that the RB driver named Kawasuke Yuichi was deliberately provoking her, which made her gnash her teeth in anger.
As the race progressed, Kawasuke Yuichi and Nie Yichen gradually distanced themselves from the other drivers behind them. The two shuttled through the streets, getting faster and faster. After driving on the ring road, they reached a speed of 180 yards.
"Haha, Nie Yichen, you will lose."
The Aventador in front was equipped with a loudspeaker, and Li Hengjiang's proud voice came from inside. Then the Aventador roared, speeding up significantly, and distanced itself from the old Jetta.
"Asshole."
Nie Yichen cursed secretly, knowing that if there was no accident today, she would definitely lose.
After turning a sharp corner, the sound of sirens suddenly came from the front, and a row of police cars completely blocked the ring road, with red and blue lights flashing dazzlingly.
"The vehicle in front is pulled over and inspected."
There was a sound from a police car, and Nie Yichen frowned. The ring road was closed. At this moment, she couldn't change lanes, so she had to turn around and go in the opposite direction.
At the same time, the Aventador in front had the same idea. After decelerating, he drifted 180 degrees, causing the tire friction to raise acrid white smoke. The next moment, he turned around and accelerated in the opposite direction.
Nie Yichen put her right hand on the handbrake and planned to drift and turn around.
But at this moment, Chen Yang lifted her up and got under her. He sat on the driver's seat, took control of the steering wheel and said, "Hey, if you drive in the opposite direction, you can't reach the finish line."
Nie Yichen was startled, leaned on Chen Yang, and exclaimed: "What are you doing?"
"Help you."
As soon as Chen Yang finished speaking, he stepped deeply on the accelerator, and the old Jetta rushed towards the Aventador, which turned around. Nie Yichen was immediately frightened and screamed: "Ah!"
Not only Nie Yichen, but also Li Hengjiang and Kawasuke Yuichi who were sitting in the Aventador were also stunned. Kawasuke Yuichi quickly stepped on the brakes to slow down.
The two cars were traveling very fast and were about to collide. The police around them thought an explosion was going to happen and hurriedly hid behind the police cars.
But a strange scene happened. The old Jetta nodded, and the speed dropped significantly. Then it suddenly raised its head, and the front of the car tilted up. It rode on the oncoming Aventador, drove over the Aventador, flew directly up, and flew over the head of the intercepting police car.
Ye Yiqing, who was hiding behind the police car, looked at the old Jetta and stared.She was dumbfounded. She received an order tonight to perform the task of intercepting a drag racing gang, but she didn't expect to see such car stunts.
Then, an even more unexpected scene appeared in front of her. Her landlord, Chen Yang, actually appeared in the driver's seat of the old Jetta.
"How could it be him?" Ye Yiqing's expression changed. She took a closer look and found that there was a woman sitting on Chen Yang's body. She immediately frowned: "This guy is really not a good guy. He actually has a woman sitting on him while racing, and he is not mainstream. What a bad idea."
With a clang, the old Jetta ran over the Aventador, jumped over the police car, landed on the driveway, and sped away, leaving behind a group of dumbfounded police officers.
Aventador stopped. Kawasuke Yuichi and Li Hengjiang both stared blankly ahead, sweating profusely and pale with fear. When the old Jetta rushed over just now, they both thought their lives were over.
Looking at the police who were surrounding him, Li Hengjiang came back to his senses and remembered Chen Yang who was sitting in the driver's seat just now. He punched the door panel hard and cursed viciously: "You bastard, you were deceived by that kid. I will never let him go."
